name: Seating Arrangement — Circular
shortcutSummary: In circular arrangements, draw a circle with equally spaced positions. Clockwise = Right, Anticlockwise = Left. 'Facing center' means everyone looks inward; 'facing outward' means everyone looks out.
conceptExplanation: Circular and Rectangular seating arrangement questions involve people sitting around a circular table or rectangular table. You must determine positions based on who sits next to whom, who faces whom, and directional clues.

subtopics.name: Seating Arrangement — Circular — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Circular and Rectangular seating arrangement questions involve people sitting around a circular table or rectangular table. You must determine positions based on who sits next to whom, who faces whom, and directional clues.
shortcuts: Center-Facing Convention: If facing center, the person to your immediate left is in the clockwise direction.
Outward-Facing Reversal: If facing outward, left and right swap compared to facing center.
Opposite Position: In a circle of n people, the person directly opposite is n/2 positions away.
